text:
{
  "design": {
    "theme": "chalk",
    "picture_style": "illustration"
  },
  "flow": [
    {"slide": 1, "does": "Recall equal sharing and division facts", "look_at": {"kind": "picture", "shows": "Twelve counters shared into three equal groups"}, "teaches": []},
    {"slide": 2, "does": "Introduce the approved objectives", "look_at": {"kind": "none", "shows": null}, "teaches": []},
    {"slide": 3, "does": "Model finding a unit fraction", "look_at": {"kind": "diagram", "shows": "Twenty-four shared into four equal parts"}, "teaches": [1]},
    {"slide": 4, "does": "Check unit fractions with a closely matched task", "look_at": {"kind": "none", "shows": null}, "teaches": [1]},
    {"slide": 5, "does": "Model finding a non-unit fraction", "look_at": {"kind": "diagram", "shows": "Three of four equal parts of twenty-four"}, "teaches": [2]},
    {"slide": 6, "does": "Check non-unit fractions with a closely matched task", "look_at": {"kind": "none", "shows": null}, "teaches": [2]},
    {"slide": 7, "does": "Correct dividing by the numerator", "look_at": {"kind": "diagram", "shows": "Two selected fifths of thirty"}, "teaches": [1, 2]},
    {"slide": 8, "does": "Check which calculation matches a fraction", "look_at": {"kind": "none", "shows": null}, "teaches": [2]},
    {"slide": 9, "does": "Model a money word problem", "look_at": {"kind": "diagram", "shows": "Three selected fifths of thirty-five pounds"}, "teaches": [2, 3]},
    {"slide": 10, "does": "Check a closely matched money problem", "look_at": {"kind": "none", "shows": null}, "teaches": [1, 2, 3]},
    {"slide": 11, "does": "Apply fractions to quantities and measures", "look_at": {"kind": "none", "shows": null}, "teaches": [1, 2, 3]},
    {"slide": 12, "does": "Apply the method to a new decision problem", "look_at": {"kind": "none", "shows": null}, "teaches": [2, 3]}
  ],
  "title": {
    "template": "title",
    "heading": "Fractions of amounts",
    "lead": "Recall: 12 shared equally into 3 groups. How many in each?",
    "picture": {
      "shows": "twelve counters arranged in three equal groups",
      "must_see": ["three separate rings", "four counters per ring"],
      "subject": "generic"
    }
  },
  "slides": [
    {
      "template": "visual-text",
      "heading": "Find one quarter of 24",
      "lead": "The denominator tells us to make 4 equal parts.",
      "points": [
        "24 ÷ 4 = 6",
        {"label": "Unit fraction", "text": "The numerator is 1: take one part."}
      ],
      "figure": {
        "kind": "bar-model",
        "shows": "24 split into four equal parts, with one part selected",
        "alt": "A bar with total 24 has four equal parts of 6. One part is shaded.",
        "title": null,
        "bars": [{"label": "¼ of 24", "whole": 24, "parts": 4, "values": null, "shaded": 1, "unknown": "none", "unit": null}],
        "combined": null
      }
    },
    {
      "template": "question-set",
      "heading": "Find one equal part",
      "questions": [
        "Find ¼ of 28.",
        "Find ⅓ of 27.",
        "Find ⅙ of 42."
      ],
      "instruction": "Write a division calculation for each.",
      "picture": null
    },
    {
      "template": "visual-text",
      "heading": "Find three quarters of 24",
      "lead": "Divide to find one part. Multiply to take three parts.",
      "points": [
        "One quarter: 24 ÷ 4 = 6",
        "Three quarters: 6 × 3 = 18"
      ],
      "figure": {
        "kind": "bar-model",
        "shows": "three of four equal parts of 24 selected",
        "alt": "A bar with total 24 has four equal parts of 6. Three parts are shaded.",
        "title": null,
        "bars": [{"label": "¾ of 24", "whole": 24, "parts": 4, "values": null, "shaded": 3, "unknown": "none", "unit": null}],
        "combined": null
      }
    },
    {
      "template": "question-set",
      "heading": "Find several equal parts",
      "questions": [
        "Find ¾ of 28.",
        "Find ⅔ of 27.",
        "Find ⅚ of 42."
      ],
      "instruction": "Show the division, then the multiplication.",
      "picture": null
    },
    {
      "template": "visual-text",
      "heading": "Which number do we divide by?",
      "lead": "For ⅖ of 30, dividing by 2 makes halves, not fifths.",
      "points": [
        "The denominator makes the parts: 30 ÷ 5 = 6.",
        "The numerator selects the parts: 6 × 2 = 12."
      ],
      "figure": {
        "kind": "bar-model",
        "shows": "30 divided into fifths, with two parts selected",
        "alt": "A bar with total 30 has five equal parts of 6. Two parts are shaded.",
        "title": null,
        "bars": [{"label": "⅖ of 30", "whole": 30, "parts": 5, "values": null, "shaded": 2, "unknown": "none", "unit": null}],
        "combined": null
      }
    },
    {
      "template": "hinge",
      "heading": "Choose the calculation",
      "stem": "Which calculation finds ⅖ of 40?",
      "options": [
        "40 ÷ 2 × 5",
        "40 ÷ 5",
        "40 ÷ 5 × 2",
        "40 × 2"
      ],
      "correct": 3
    },
    {
      "template": "visual-text",
      "heading": "A fraction of money",
      "lead": "Aisha has £35. She spends ⅗ of it. How much does she spend?",
      "points": [
        "One fifth: £35 ÷ 5 = £7",
        "Three fifths: £7 × 3 = £21"
      ],
      "figure": {
        "kind": "bar-model",
        "shows": "three fifths of £35 selected as money spent",
        "alt": "A bar with total £35 has five equal parts of £7. Three parts are shaded.",
        "title": null,
        "bars": [{"label": "Spent", "whole": 35, "parts": 5, "values": null, "shaded": 3, "unknown": "none", "unit": "£"}],
        "combined": null
      }
    },
    {
      "template": "question-set",
      "heading": "Solve the money problems",
      "questions": [
        "Ben has £40. He spends ⅗ of it. How much does he spend?",
        "Lily has £32. She saves ¼ of it. How much does she save?",
        "Sam has £36. He donates ⅔ of it. How much does he donate?"
      ],
      "instruction": "Write your working and include £ in each answer.",
      "picture": null
    },
    {
      "template": "practice",
      "heading": "Quantities and measures",
      "questions": [
        "A box holds 48 pencils. ⅜ are blue. How many are blue?",
        "A ribbon is 56 cm long. Mia cuts off ¼ of it. How long is the piece?",
        "A jug holds 45 ml of juice. ⅖ is poured out. How much is poured out?"
      ],
      "instruction": "Solve each problem. Include the correct unit.",
      "picture": null
    },
    {
      "template": "practice",
      "heading": "Choose a picnic pack",
      "questions": [
        "Pack A has 30 rolls; ⅖ are cheese rolls. How many are cheese?",
        "Pack B has 35 rolls; ⅗ are cheese rolls. How many are cheese?",
        "Stretch: You need 18 cheese rolls. Which pack has enough? Explain."
      ],
      "instruction": "Calculate, then use your answers to decide.",
      "picture": null
    }
  ]
}
